result: BLOCKER CONFIRMED BY RUNTIME EVIDENCE: background driver initialization survives into process exit
observed_evidence: engine47final.log reports EngineSession replay timeout and committed-match exit -11 after842 checksums verified.
traces47final/verify-match.log reports pthread priority assertion after842 checksums verified.
verify-shutdown-repro/backtrace.log reports one GDB run exited normally; hung-cli-backtrace.log reports no process at attach.
static_findings: Broker backendLifetime initializes function-static Runtime before DeviceBroker completes construction; broker static destructor joins coordinator before Runtime static destructor.
Map clears/reset drains pipeline before GradientRuntime member destruction, which precedes ComputeExecutor destruction.
Completion tickets retain separate lifetime mutex; executor stop joins jobs/workers before marking lifetime executor null.
Broker locks broker mutex then state mutex; stop and submit release state mutex before acquiring broker mutex through notify. No confirmed inversion.
OwnedGradientField serviceRetained alias retains state across executionState reset and reservation release.
Runtime execution lane retains parent shared Device across lane cleanup and lanesMutex lock.
GlobalContainer has duplicate NET_Quit on current unchanged master; SDL_net3.2.0 initialize_count guard makes repeated noninitialized quit no-op, so no confirmed defect from that duplication.
limits: No build, runtime reproduction, debugger attachment or source edits performed by this reviewer.
Static audit cannot establish exit safety or dismiss demonstrated intermittent failures.
CPU versus GPU bounded reproduction and a failing-thread native backtrace remain necessary to localize failure.

followup_evidence.independent_reading: Main is in __run_exit_handlers joining a std::thread. Coordinator remains in NVIDIA OpenCL driver mutex acquisition with driver helper threads alive. Simulation had already verified842 checksums.
followup_evidence.other_reviewer_report: final_engine_review reported explicit CPU2 three exits0; default GPU2 two SIGABRT plus one hang. This reviewer inspected the GDB stack, did not run those reproductions.

shutdown_recommendations: Join/drain background coordinator while driver/SDL services are still live, before process exit handlers run.
Provide restart for repeated GlobalContainer/HeadlessGlobals lifecycles.
GlobalContainer teardown hook does not cover direct OpenCL unit suites without globals; shared TestMain/process-final shutdown must cover those.
Do not infer driver atexit state remains live from a shared_ptr<Device>; async driver load may register exit handlers after broker/Runtime destructor registration.

Consider explicit Runtime/device/API release before exit too; static Runtime destruction contains OpenCL release and SDL_UnloadObject calls. Actual driver atexit cause is inferred from stack and async timing, not symbol-proven.
